description_en: Queries the list of online users in a channel. The response does not include detailed user information
description_zh: 查询频道在线用户列表，不包含详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-channel-participants --app-id aec0000 --channel-id testId --order asc --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChannelParticipants

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and view this ID in the Alibaba Cloud console. Only one ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only one ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 加入的频道，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending.

- **desc** (default): descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，取值：

- **asc**：递增。

- **desc**（默认值）：递减
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The number of users per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示用户数量，默认每页显示10条用户数据
parameters.name: page_size
